title: Name every produced or consumed artifact theme-first

facts.note: Source validation phase is CONFIRM (confirm-blocking); the harness must report the phase.

Source subject_kind=artifact: every produced or consumed artifact/contract identity is checked, whether new, renamed or pre-existing. An observer must enumerate these identities; no path or change gate is implied by the source.
Detector finding from the naming_pattern validator variant, carrying artifact_name and reason.

fires: At CONFIRM, a produced or consumed artifact identity does not parse as theme:...:aspect
At CONFIRM, an artifact identity's leading theme is not declared in plan/_themes.yaml (e.g. undeclared:result)
At CONFIRM, a contract identity uses uppercase or non-kebab tokens (e.g. Bad:Theme)
At CONFIRM, an existing, unchanged artifact identity is dot-only with no theme segment (e.g. gesture.raw)
doesNotFire: Every produced and consumed artifact/contract identity parses under the grammar, uses kebab-case tokens, and starts with a theme declared in plan/_themes.yaml
The name being checked is not a produced or consumed artifact/contract identity

given: A produced or consumed artifact/contract identity exists (new, renamed or pre-existing)
then: The identity must be theme-first: it parses as {theme}(:{category})*:{aspect}(.{variant})?, every colon- or dot-separated token is kebab-case, and the leading theme is declared in plan/_themes.yaml.
prefer: Start the name with a theme declared in plan/_themes.yaml, then optional categories, then the aspect, then an optional .variant (e.g. commons:identifiers.uuid, commons:ux:foundations:color, orders:checkout.submitted, inventory:stock)
Use lowercase kebab-case for every token between colons and dots
If no fitting theme exists, declare it in the canonical theme map first rather than inventing it inline
avoid: Using a leading theme that is not declared in plan/_themes.yaml (e.g. undeclared:result)
Names without a theme:aspect colon structure, such as dot-only names (e.g. gesture.raw)
why: Artifact identities are the join keys between producers and consumers and contract paths mirror them; a fixed theme-first grammar anchored to a canonical theme map keeps them parseable, unambiguous and consistently located.
evidence: The planner_artifact_theme_first_identity validator (naming_pattern, CONFIRM, confirm-blocking) reports no finding for any produced/consumed artifact
On failure, the finding names artifact_name and reason
verifier_detail: Term artifact_theme_first_identity: the theme-first identity rule for a produced artifact/contract name
Grammar: {theme}(:{category})*:{aspect}(.{variant})? — at least one colon is required (theme plus aspect); categories are repeatable; variant is optional and dot-separated
Each colon/dot token must be kebab-case
Theme source: plan/_themes.yaml — leading theme must be declared there
examples_bad: undeclared:result (theme not declared); Bad:Theme (not kebab-case); gesture.raw (no theme:aspect structure)

validation: family=format, template=naming_pattern, variant=planner_artifact_theme_first_identity, phase=CONFIRM, enforcement=confirm-blocking, subject_kind=artifact; applies to all produced/consumed identities, not only changed ones
